post_ship_review.fix: 10 CONFIRMED + 1 NEEDS_NUANCE, all landed: (1) §2.3 low-freq max wavelength corrected to λ_max=2π·b^{(d-2)/d} (≈54,410 for d=128), not the d→∞ limit 2π·10000; (2) §2.3 callout fixed self-contradiction — the risk is extrapolating a low-freq phase *without* interpolating, not interpolation itself; (3) §6.1/§6.5/TL;DR/Q12 reframed YaRN as two core components (NTK-by-parts + temperature scaling); attention scale is an implementation of temperature scaling via the cos/sin cache, not an independent third component; (4) §6.4/Q24 added a partial-RoPE caveat (GPT-NeoX rotary_pct<1, MLA decoupled key) where the cos/sin-scale ≡ global-temperature equivalence no longer holds strictly (NEEDS_NUANCE — original claim not wrong, just underspecified); (5) §7.2/§7.4 table LongRoPE fine-tune steps corrected 400→≈1000 (400 was YaRN's number, mis-copied); (6) §7.4 callout removed the overclaim that DeepSeek-V2/Llama-3.1 use LongRoPE-style short/long dual scaling tables (Llama-3.1 uses a single piecewise-linear scaling function; DeepSeek-V2 uses standard YaRN); (7) §10.1 callout corrected attention-sink's motivation (prevents PPL blow-up from losing the softmax 'trash bin', not a retrieval fix) to stop contradicting §10.3; (8) §11.4-area Q22 MLA additive decomposition relabeled — the RoPE term is content interaction modulated by relative rotation, not a pure 'position' term; (9) §12.3 table Ring Attention memory corrected from O(L²/P) to persistent O(Ld/P) + local block peak O(L²/P²), consistent with §11.1; (10) §11.3 + reference footer attributed FlashAttention-3 to Shah et al. 2024 (Tri Dao co-author), separated from Dao et al. 2022-2023 (v1/v2); (11) Q25 per-dim scaling search attributed only to LongRoPE (YaRN uses an analytical NTK-by-parts ramp, no search).
